1.web: Then he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits its length, and twenty cubits its breadth, and ten cubits its height.
1.asv: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.

2.web: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass; and its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.
2.asv: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass; and the height thereof was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits compassed it round about.

3.web: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
3.asv: And under it was the likeness of oxen, which did compass it round about, for ten cubits, compassing the sea round about. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

4.web: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set on them above, and all their hinder parts were inward.
4.asv: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set upon them above, and all their hinder parts were inward.

5.web: It was a hand breadth thick; and its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily: it received and held three thousand baths.
5.asv: And it was a handbreadth thick; and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily: it received and held three thousand baths.

6.web: He made also ten basins, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them; such things as belonged to the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
6.asv: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them; such things as belonged to the burnt-offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

7.web: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
7.asv: And he made the ten candlesticks of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

8.web: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.
8.asv: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made a hundred basins of gold.

9.web: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with brass.
9.asv: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

10.web: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.
10.asv: And he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.

11.web: Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basins. So Huram made an end of doing the work that he did for king Solomon in God’s house:
11.asv: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basins. So Huram made an end of doing the work that he wrought for king Solomon in the house of God:

12.web: the two pillars, and the bowls, and the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, and the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars,
12.asv: the two pillars, and the bowls, and the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, and the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars,

13.web: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.
13.asv: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were upon the pillars.

14.web: He made also the bases, and the basins made he on the bases;
14.asv: He made also the bases, and the lavers made he upon the bases;

15.web: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.
15.asv: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.

16.web: Huram his father also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for king Solomon for Yahweh’s house of bright brass.
16.asv: The pots also, and the shovels, and the flesh-hooks, and all the vessels thereof, did Huram his father make for king Solomon, for the house of Jehovah, of bright brass.

17.web: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
17.asv: In the plain of the Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.

18.web: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
18.asv: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.

19.web: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house, the golden altar also, and the tables with the show bread on them;
19.asv: And Solomon made all the vessels that were in the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon was the showbread;

20.web: and the lamp stands with their lamps, to burn according to the ordinance before the oracle, of pure gold;
20.asv: and the candlesticks with their lamps, to burn according to the ordinance before the oracle, of pure gold;

21.web: and the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, of gold, and that perfect gold;
21.asv: and the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, of gold, and that perfect gold;

22.web: and the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold: and as for the entry of the house, the inner doors of it for the most holy place, and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold.
22.asv: and the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and the firepans, of pure gold. And as for the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple, were of gold.
